records.rationale:
In `pkg/expr/reader.go`, SQL queries are now gated by `enableSqlExpressions(h)` and return `fmt.Errorf("sqlExpressions is not implemented")` when it returns false. But `enableSqlExpressions` is implemented to always return `false`:

```go
enabled := !h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions)
if enabled { return false }
return false
```

So SQL expressions are *never* enabled (even when the flag is enabled), and the user-facing error message will always be returned. This is a verifiable functional defect introduced by the diff.
